summary: Mingteng International Corporation Inc., a Wuxi-based metal door and trim manufacturer listed on a US exchange, filed a 6-K reporting entry into a Share Transfer Agreement dated October 6, 2026 with Mr. ZHENG Delin and HK Phoenix Gateway Alliance Limited. The company acquired 10,000 ordinary shares, or 100% of the target, for USD 15,000,000 cash, fully paid at closing. The deal closed the same day, giving Mingteng indirect ownership of PRC WFOE Shanghai Shangyun Yingfei Technology and its subsidiary Shanghai Minwen Industrial. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock was disclosed.
